title: Refactor Global Variables
problem_statement: Global variables are used for database connections, which can lead to maintainability issues.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased difficulty in maintaining and testing the code.
suggested_approach: Refactor to use dependency injection for database connections.
success_criteria: No global variables for database connections.

title: Implement Parameterized Queries
problem_statement: Direct SQL query execution without parameterization poses a security risk.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased risk of SQL injection attacks.
suggested_approach: Refactor queries to use prepared statements or ORM.
